gloss: to suddenly remember; to recall out of the blue

definitions.gloss: to suddenly remember; to recall out of the blue
definitions.explanation: To have a memory come to mind unexpectedly, without deliberately trying to recall it.

examples.japanese: ⟦ふと→ふと：00048_futo⟧⟦{昔|むかし}→昔：01515_mukashi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧こと⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{思|おも}い{出|だ}した→思い出す：01258_omoidasu⟧。
examples.english: I suddenly remembered something from the past.

examples.japanese: ⟦{歩|ある}いていたら→歩く：00538_aruku⟧、⟦ふと→ふと：00048_futo⟧⟦{友人|ゆうじん}→友人：03649_yuujin⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{言葉|ことば}→言葉：02880_kotoba⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{思|おも}い{出|だ}した→思い出す：01258_omoidasu⟧。
examples.english: While walking, I suddenly recalled my friend's words.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{匂|にお}い→匂い：00874_nioi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{嗅|か}ぐ→嗅ぐ：02036_kagu⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧、⟦ふと→ふと：00048_futo⟧⟦{子供|こども}→子供：00554_kodomo⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{頃|ころ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{思|おも}い{出|だ}す→思い出す：01258_omoidasu⟧。
examples.english: When I smell this scent, it suddenly brings back memories of my childhood.

notes:
Combines the adverb ⟦ふと→ふと：00048_futo⟧ (suddenly, unexpectedly) with ⟦{思|おも}い{出|だ}す→思い出す：01258_omoidasu⟧ (to remember). The key nuance is that the memory surfaces involuntarily — triggered by a sensation, a scene, or seemingly nothing at all. Very common in everyday conversation and narrative writing.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦ふと→ふと：00048_futo⟧⟦{昔|むかし}→昔：01515_mukashi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{思|おも}い{出|だ}す→思い出す：01258_omoidasu⟧: to suddenly recall the past
- ⟦ふと→ふと：00048_futo⟧⟦{母|はは}→母：00549_haha⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧こと⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{思|おも}い{出|だ}す→思い出す：01258_omoidasu⟧: to suddenly think of one's mother
- ふと{思|おも}い{出|だ}したよう⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧: as if suddenly remembering

USAGE:
⟦ふと→ふと：00048_futo⟧ can also combine with other verbs to express sudden, unplanned actions:
- ⟦ふと→ふと：00048_futo⟧⟦{気|き}がつく→気がつく：21794_kigatsuku⟧: to suddenly notice
- ⟦ふと→ふと：00048_futo⟧⟦{見|み}る→見る：00283_miru⟧: to glance inadvertently
- ⟦ふと→ふと：00048_futo⟧⟦{目|め}が{覚|さ}める→目が覚める：23498_megasameru⟧: to wake up suddenly
